title: ShareSafe: Metadata Remover
originalShortDescription: Remove photo location & EXIF metadata. Optional Pro editing for private details.
shortDescription: Remove photo metadata on-device. Keep originals. Optional Pro editing.
originalFullDescription:
Remove location, camera and timestamp metadata from photos before you share them. ShareSafe creates fresh JPEG copies on your device while keeping your originals untouched.

FREE PHOTO CLEANING + PRIVACY CHECK
- Check selected EXIF location, date/time and camera/device fields before cleaning
- Create fresh JPEG copies without the original embedded metadata
- Check exported copies again for the selected fields
- Replace original filenames with neutral filenames
- Choose JPEG quality, export individual photos or one ZIP, and save to your gallery

Privacy Check reports readable field presence, not a guarantee of anonymity. Android or your file provider may hide metadata. Unsupported or unreadable checks are marked unknown, not safe.

OPTIONAL SHARESAFE PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Advanced Edit adds privacy tools for one photo at a time:
- Face Assist finds possible faces on-device using a bundled model, without a model download
- Review suggestions and apply selected solid covers, or dismiss them
- Add manual solid Cover areas for private text, names, addresses, IDs, faces or number plates
- Select, move, resize, edit numerically or delete individual areas
- Optional blur and pixelation, zoom, pan, undo and redo
- Export a flattened JPEG copy

Face Assist detects possible faces, not identities. It can miss faces or suggest the wrong area. It does not automatically detect text, IDs or number plates. Always review the result.

Metadata cleaning and Privacy Check stay free. Pro is a permanent one-time Google Play purchase, with no subscription. Your local price is shown before purchase. Existing Pro owners receive the new Pro tools. Use Restore Pro purchase with the Google Play account that bought Pro.

ON-DEVICE PHOTO PROCESSING
Photo cleaning, editing and face detection happen on your device. ShareSafe does not upload photos or detection results to Kreativ or Google. There are no ads and no ShareSafe account. Google Play handles optional purchases.

The Play edition includes Google ML Kit, which collects device/app information, per-installation identifiers, performance/error metrics and feature usage/configuration information. These SDK metrics are separate from photo content. See the privacy policy for details.

IMPORTANT PRIVACY DETAILS
Removing metadata does not hide information visible inside an image. Review every exported copy before sharing. Blur and pixelation may still reveal information; use solid Cover for sensitive details.

Copies are JPEGs, not identical backups. Large images may be resized, transparency becomes white and animated inputs export one frame. Originals are not changed.

Privacy policy: https://madebykreativ.com/privacy/sharesafe/
Support: info@madebykreativ.com
